Western Europe was the most affected area, with reports of record-breaking temperatures in France, Ireland and the United Kingdom. A second, more severe heatwave began on 17 June, just days before the summer solstice. In the United Kingdom, temperatures peaked at 38.0 °C (100.4 °F).
